summary: Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (RCGI): experimental diffuse 3D lighting with dense world-space probes.
summaryText: Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (RCGI): experimental diffuse 3D lighting with dense world-space probes.
remarks: This dense-grid implementation is not Split Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (SRCGI). Probes fill a cube around the scene; each cascade doubles probe spacing, quadruples directions and quadruples ray length, so near occluders are resolved spatially and distant light directionally. Intervals are traced on the shader BVH when lighting needs updating and merged top-down; shading interpolates a per-probe irradiance map, which also feeds the next frame's bounce. Provide [`ITraceGeometry`](<xref:ITraceGeometry>) through [`RCGI.Geometry`](<xref:RCGI#Geometry>) and send the output to tone mapping. The material model is diffuse with per-triangle emission, as in [`PTGI`](<xref:PTGI>).
